title: Add a WebSocket/webhook event (gateway.events[]) to config.yaml

type.description: ws (push to subscribed clients) | http (webhook POST).

exchange.description: Source exchange the gateway binds to (ws).

auth.description: Auth-provider name used to verify the subscribe token.

requireAuth.description: Set false to make auth optional (anonymous may subscribe).

actions.description: Actions the subscriber must hold (OR-semantics). Requires auth.

scopeClaim.description: Claim used to scope delivery per-user; requires payloadKey.

payloadKey.description: Payload field compared against scopeClaim — only matching messages are forwarded.

httpMethod.description: HTTP method for the webhook (http) — written as method.

overwrite.description: Update the entry if it already exists (default: leave it untouched).
